english.title: Discharge firearm within 50 feet of highway
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without lawful authority or excuse discharged a firearm namely **(..SPECIFY FIREARM..), within fifty feet of the centre of a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..), which consisted of or comprised a carriageway , in consequence of which a user of the highway was injured, interrupted, or endangered
english.legislation: Contrary to section 161(2)(b) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes:
(i) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H1690 and H2100.
(ii) Section 161(2)(b) also applies to the lighting of fires.
(iii) See offence wordings of similar offences as follows: H1076, H1360, and H1692.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant without lawful authority or excuse discharged a firearm, namely **(..SPECIFY FIREARM..), within fifty feet of the centre of a highway, namely **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY..), which consisted of or comprised a carriageway , in consequence of which a user of the highway was injured, interrupted, or endangered.
